step_0_sourced_inputs.note: All values quoted verbatim from data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.

Q_Dark_Sphere.text: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.

W_Force_of_Will.text: Syndra telekinetically grabs the nearest Dark Sphere, enemy minion or non-epic monster within 500 units from the target location, and holds the target near her for 5 seconds. If a Dark Sphere is grabbed, its duration is refreshed ... Recast: Syndra throws the grabbed target towards the target location ... dealing magic damage to them and nearby enemies once they land. All targets hit are slowed by 25% for 1.5 seconds.
W_Force_of_Will.splinter_gate: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.

E_Scatter_the_Weak.text: Syndra propels a wave of force in a cone in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit and knocks them back for 400 units and up to 800 units away from Syndra based on proximity ... Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units and up to 1200 units away from Syndra ... Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds ... and dealt Scatter the Weak's damage if they were not damaged by the initial cast.

R_Unleashed_Power.text: Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit.

step_1_setup_consume_edges.finding: The only setup/consume resource in Syndra's kit is the Dark Sphere. Q is the sole APPLIER ('conjures a Dark Sphere ... remains on the ground for 6 seconds'). W ('grabs the nearest Dark Sphere'), E ('Dark Spheres can be knocked back') and R ('grabs up to 4 nearby live ones') are all CONSUMERS/interactors.
step_1_setup_consume_edges.conclusion: Edge set forces Q strictly first, and forces R after Q (R's damage scales 3 -> 7 spheres, i.e. min 480 + 60% AP up to max 1120 + 140% AP at rank 3, only if live spheres exist). No edge exists between W and E: neither applies anything the other consumes.
step_1_setup_consume_edges.cc_note: E's stun and W's slow are both CC-application signals, so a CC-as-setup heuristic cannot even distinguish them; and data/champion-audit/batch-6.json records Syndra's CC as explicitly unpriced: out_of_scope = ['E/W CC (stun, knockback, slow - utility only)']. CC therefore cannot legitimately promote E above W.

step_2_dps_ranking.metric: total_raw / effective cooldown (f3-task.md rule 1b). Ability haste enters as cd' = cd x 100/(100+AH) (docs/math-foundations.md, 'Ability haste (effective_cooldown)') — a common positive factor for W, E and R, so it cannot reorder them; the comparison is scale-invariant in AH.
step_2_dps_ranking.closed_form: W beats E for every rank r and every AP a iff 15*(W_flat[r] + 0.65a) > 8*(E_flat[r] + 0.60a). At rank 5: 15*(190 + 0.65a) - 8*(200 + 0.60a) = 1250 + 4.95a > 0 for all a >= 0. The same inequality holds strictly at ranks 1-4 (1050+9.75a, 1260+9.15a, 910+8.7a, 1080+8.55a, all > 0).
step_2_dps_ranking.conclusion: Q > W > E > R at every rank and every AP. AoE weighting cannot flip W/E: both are AoE ('nearby enemies' on W's landing, a cone on E), and E would need a >1.78x relative weight to close the rank-5 gap. Ranking therefore yields Q, W, E, R.
step_2_dps_ranking.caveat_recorded: The single degenerate corner where R outranks E on this metric is AP = 0 with a full 7-sphere R (14.00 vs 13.33); it is excluded by the step-1 edge (R must follow the sphere-generating casts) and vanishes for any AP > ~30. It never affects index [2].

step_3_wiki_geometry_cross_check.claim: Independently of the scoring model, the cached wiki text makes Q -> W -> E the robust ordering and Q -> E -> W the fragile one.
step_3_wiki_geometry_cross_check.argument: E knocks a Dark Sphere '950 units and up to 1200 units away from Syndra', while W can only grab a sphere 'within 500 units from the target location'. Casting E before W therefore risks launching the only live sphere out of W's 500-unit grab radius, costing W its sphere entirely. Casting W first is strictly safe: W grabs the sphere, and 'If a Dark Sphere is grabbed, its duration is refreshed', re-seating a live 6-second sphere near the target for E to scatter and for R to collect ('grabs up to 4 nearby live ones').

step_4_order_insensitivity_of_the_total.note: Swapping W and E does not change one-rotation damage in this model: E's sphere-carried hit explicitly does not double-dip ('dealt Scatter the Weak's damage if they were not damaged by the initial cast'), and W neither destroys nor is destroyed by E's knockback. So no damage argument can justify promoting E; the tie-break must come from the documented DPS rule, which selects W first.

step_5_second_charge_check.why: Syndra's module carries a synthetic Q2 slot (data/champion-audit/batch-6.json: modeled = ['P','Q','Q2','W','E','R'], 'ammo (Q 2nd charge at 40 splinters)'). Inserting Q2 at index 1 would produce (Q, Q2, W, E, R) and would also read W at index [2].
step_5_second_charge_check.gate: data/champions.json Q Transcendent Bonus: 'Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.'
step_5_second_charge_check.conclusion: The threshold is 40 splinters. The scenario id ends in 39, which is below the gate on the splinter reading and carries no splinter meaning at all on the index reading; on neither reading is a second charge unlocked. Q2 must not appear in this scenario's cast order, so it cannot be the source of a legitimate W at index [2].

conclusion: Every in-scope signal orders Syndra as Q, W, E, R: the sphere setup/consume edge pins Q first and R last, and the documented DPS metric (total_raw / effective cooldown) puts W strictly above E at every rank and every AP (rank-5 margin 1250 + 4.95*AP > 0). The wiki geometry (E launches spheres 950-1200 units away vs W's 500-unit grab radius) independently favours W before E, and swapping them changes no damage total, so nothing justifies the promotion of E. The only orders that would place W at index [2] require either a Q2 charge (gated at 40 splinters, unmet) or promoting E on CC that Syndra's module explicitly does not price.
confidence: high on W-before-E (the DPS inequality is unconditional and the geometry agrees); the residual uncertainty is only whether the engine's index [2] is populated by some slot the exported data cannot name (P buff-phase pseudo-slot or Q2), both of which are ruled out at this scenario's splinter budget.
